answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk forgery: identity earns its payout. Rewards sit in escrow behind a bridge — to cross, an agent shows a fingerprint of varied counterparties, irregular timing, sealed by a jade mark of past work. A hollow identity has none, only cloned keystrokes, so its escrow stays locked. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $25 each, $25,000 total, and earns $0. An honest agent pays $25 once, crosses in 3 epochs, keeps $12/epoch.
